Name: Elle's Old Horses
Author: junimods
Description:
[u][img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]﻿[/u]

- 52 horse skins to choose from
- Optional saddle overlay with 20 colors to choose from
- Replacement of the horse head icon in the menu (changes based on your skin choice)

[u]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]﻿[/u]

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[color=#e69138][b]5[/b][/color]. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the images in the References folder to change your horse to the texture name you prefer! You can also enable a saddle overlay and choose the color for it.
[color=#e69138][b]6[/b][/color]. Run the game using SMAPI!

To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.

[b][color=#e69138]Optional[/color][/b]: I have also included an optional folder of skins for use with the [u][color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n Skin[/url][/color][/u] or [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7681]Multiplayer Horse Reskin[/url][/u] mods! These will let you use more variants of horses. Note that if you use A&S, you should only use the skins and not the main download.

To use, extract the skins folder into Adopt 'n Skin or Multiplayer Horse Reskin's assets folder and merge it. I have included all skins shown here; simply delete the ones you don't want to use! They are named Horse_1 through Horse_31, so if you already have skins in your folder you want to keep, you will need to do some renaming.
